question: To which of the following states does the dance drama ‘Khyal’ belong?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rajasthan. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points.__**

__
 
• **Khyal is a folk play** that involves dance also.

 
• **Women** do not participate in **Bhawai dances.**

 
• **Khayal dance** is performed by men of the **Bhawai tribe of Rajasthan.**

 
• It is believed that during the 16th century, the Jats only practised this folk dance.
 
• The **Bhawai tribes** picked it up from the **Jats** and continued to date.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Folk dances of Rajasthan are as follows:**

 
• Gidar dance is one of the famous folk dances of Rajasthan.

 
 
• It is a famous dance of the Shekhawati region performed on the occasion of ' Holi '.
 
• Only men perform this dance.
 
• The main area of ​​Gidad dance is Shekhawati, in which the areas of Sikar, Laxmangarh, Churu, Jhunjhunu, Ramgarh and Sujangarh etc. are counted.
 
 
 
• Dhol Dance: This is the famous dance of Jalore which is done by men.
 
 
• Four or five dhols are beaten together in it.
 
• Dhol dance is generally performed at a wedding ceremony.
 
 
 
• Bamarsia Dance: A large Nagada is used in this dance.
 
 
• Holi's song and Rasia are also sung along with dance.
 
• This is performed in the regions of Bharatpur and Alwar.
 
 
 
• Dandiya Dance: It is a popular dance of Marwar.
 
 
• In this dance, a group of men dances with long sticks in their hands.
